data.name: Langtang glacier collapse & Trishuli debris flood
data.cause: Langtang glacier/rock collapse on 26 Aug and a debris flood down the Trishuli, not rain

forecast.reason: Not a rain flood: the Trishuli flood came from a glacier/rock collapse, so rainfall and soil moisture cannot forecast it. The notebook leaves it out of the forecasting data (cell 34), and so does this model.

notes: Not a rain flood: the reports give a glacier/rock collapse as the cause, not rain.
